memory_candidates.content: validate-artifact.sh's Tier Justification measurement check extracts a phase's suite-name CLAIM by grepping the whole justification block for 'test-[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.sh'. A justification that inlines the phase's declared file paths therefore turns any declared test-suite PATH into a phantom suitelist claim, flipping claim_kind from empty (out of scope, silently passed over) to suitelist and emitting a false 'under-verifies' warning naming every other suite the selector returns. The authoring fix is to reference the phase's `Files to modify` set by name in the justification rather than inlining paths -- which also keeps the field to the one sentence the standard asks for. Applies to any phase whose declared paths include a test file.
